blocks.text: Real Russian sentences that use what the lesson teaches. Type the missing word, or pick it, until it turns green.

These are real sentences: from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR), with their English translations, and from the public-domain Russian books in this library, with author and title. Each blank is the word the sentence really has; the word in brackets is its dictionary form.

exercises.q: The wind is coming from the southeast.
exercises.why: «с» + genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Tom has been taken off life support.
exercises.why: «от» + genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Я думаю, что Том — один из ___ (заговорщики).
exercises.prompt: I think that Tom is a part of the conspiracy.
exercises.why: «из» + genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Эй, слезь с ___ (мой велосипед).
exercises.why: «с» + genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Избавься от ___ (эта блевотина) сам!
exercises.prompt: Get rid of this vomit yourself!
exercises.why: «от» + genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Today I picked up my four-year-old nephew from kindergarten.
exercises.ru: Сегодня я забрал своего четырёхлетнего племянника из ___.
exercises.why: «из» + genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: With your approval, I would like to offer him the job.
exercises.ru: С ___, я хотел бы предложить ему эту работу.
exercises.why: «с» + genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Martin Luther King, Jr., a man of peace, was killed by an assassin's bullet.
exercises.ru: Мартин Лютер Кинг-младший, человек мира, погиб от ___ убийцы.
exercises.why: «от» + genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Его исключили из ___ (организация).
exercises.prompt: He was excluded from the society.
exercises.why: «из» + genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Настоящий закон утрачивает силу с 1 ___ (январь) 2003 года.
exercises.prompt: The current law expires on January 1, 2003.
exercises.why: «с» + genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Врачи каждый год пропагандируют прививки от ___ (грипп).
exercises.prompt: Doctors advertise the flu shot every year.
exercises.why: «от» + genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Water gushed out of the faucet.
exercises.why: «из» + genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Wipe that smirk off your face.
exercises.why: «со» + genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: The cough syrup has a licorice flavoring.
exercises.why: «от» + genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Том метко стреляет из ___ (лук).
exercises.prompt: Tom is a crack shot with a bow.
exercises.why: «из» + genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Они убрали препятствие с ___ (дорога).
exercises.prompt: They had cleared the obstacle from the road.
exercises.why: «с» + genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Чем русские отличаются от ___ (славяне)?
exercises.prompt: What's the difference between Russians and Slavs?
exercises.why: «от» + genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: I thought that Tom had gotten out of the hospital.
exercises.why: «из» + genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Cut all the fat from the meat.
exercises.why: «с» + genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: The school is a half-mile walk from my house.
exercises.why: «от» + genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
